f16.name: F-16 Fighting Falcon
f16.description: A lightweight multirole fighter aircraft known for its agility, single-engine design, and wide use by many air forces.

f22.name: F-22 Raptor
f22.description: A fifth-generation stealth air superiority fighter designed for advanced maneuverability, speed, and low radar visibility.

su57.name: Sukhoi Su-57
su57.description: A Russian fifth-generation multirole fighter designed with stealth features, high maneuverability, and advanced avionics.

mig29.name: MiG-29 Fulcrum
mig29.description: A Soviet-designed twin-engine fighter aircraft built for air superiority and known for strong maneuverability.

f14.name: F-14 Tomcat
f14.description: A twin-engine, variable-sweep wing fighter aircraft formerly used by the U.S. Navy, famous for fleet defense and long-range interception.

bf109.name: Messerschmitt Bf 109
bf109.description: A German World War II fighter aircraft that served as one of the Luftwaffe's main fighters throughout the war.

spitfire.name: Supermarine Spitfire
spitfire.description: A British World War II fighter aircraft known for its elliptical wings, agility, and role in the Battle of Britain.

p51.name: P-51 Mustang
p51.description: An American World War II long-range fighter aircraft widely recognized for escort missions and high-altitude performance.
